Bayi kendi markasını tanımlamamış; müşte: The reseller has not defined a brand; their customers see the server's default brand.
Bayinin müşterileri sunucunun genel mark: The reseller's customers will see the server's default brand, and the reseller's panel domain binding is removed too.
İsteğe bağlı. https:// ya da mailto: ile: Optional. An address starting with https:// or mailto:; shown as a "Support" link below the side menu.
İsteğe bağlı. Müşterileriniz panele bu a: Optional. If your customers open the panel at this address, your brand appears on the sign-in page. Pointing the domain at this server and setting up its certificate must be done separately; a domain can be bound to only one reseller.
Marka kaldırıldı; sunucunun markası geçe: Brand removed; the server's brand applies
Müşterileriniz sunucunun genel markasını: Your customers will see the server's default brand, and your panel domain binding is removed too.
Müşterileriniz ve onların alt hesapları: Your customers and their sub-accounts see your name and logo in the panel. If you do not define one, the server's default brand is shown.
